name: AIO SEO CRM
body:
> Project · 2026-10-10

# Summary
"AIO SEO CRM by FSC" is Kim's private, single-user web app for tracking every client website's SEO work. Built with Claude Code using the Superpowers spec, plan and subagent-driven-development flow. Repo: GitHub `First-chronicles/aio-seo-crm` (branch `main`). Runs locally at http://localhost:3000 (launch config `aio-seo-crm` in the session root).

# Stack
Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind; Supabase for Postgres, email/password auth and file storage (free tier); Zod validation; Vitest, ESLint and `tsc` with a pre-commit hook; Supabase CLI migrations (no Docker). Keys live in `.env.local` [redacted, never opened]; sign-ups are disabled and only allowed emails can log in.

# What is built (git history Oct 9 to 10, 2026)
1. **Foundation (v1):** login, Instantly-style workspace (icon rail, sidebar, top bar, dark/light theme), client management with logos (2 MB max, SVG allowed), archive and restore, settings, error and not-found pages, a module registry, seed script for Summit AZ, Pipeliners and Alphalete. 8 tasks; final review found 0 critical, 4 important issues, all fixed (suite 57/57).
2. **Client Brain module:** per-client tabs for Rules (Always/Never, scope, source, Active/Draft), Company info, Customer avatar, Services and areas, Brand voice, Tools ("No passwords here"), Files (10 MB uploads) and Notes; search, "Mark reviewed" with a 90-day "Needs review" flag, and "Copy Brain" as Markdown. Suite 77/77 at completion.
3. **CRUD everywhere:** edit and delete across Brain lists, notes, files and clients (permanent delete).
4. **SEO > Content Writing module:** "Improve" pipeline for existing pages (idea, before, in progress, live, done) with before/after GSC snapshots, a protect list of page-one queries and an automatic Up/Down/No real change verdict after 28+ days; "Plan" pipeline for new content (idea through published), overdue flags, and a side box of the client's active Brain rules.
5. Forgot and reset password pages.

# Docs
- `README.md`: setup (Supabase project, `.env.local`, disable sign-ups, `db push`, seed) and a manual checklist.
- `docs/ADDING-A-MODULE.md`: register, table, tests first, data functions, page, check and commit.
- `docs/superpowers/specs/` and `plans/`: foundation, client brain, content writing and CRUD designs (approved in chat Oct 9 to 10).
- `.superpowers/sdd/`: progress ledgers, task briefs and test logs for the foundation and brain builds.

# Status and pending
- Foundation Task 3 steps and the deferred manual checks waited on Kim's Supabase project hand-off.
- Uncommitted work in progress on Brain rules (bulk actions plus a new test file) as of Oct 22.
- Later: Vercel deployment (business use may need a Pro plan; confirm with Scott), more SEO modules, a Claude command box, importing data from the claude.ai [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker).
- Deferred minor issues are listed at the end of each progress ledger.
